Applications

Pending: check the badge, open the documents, then approve or reject. Approval is blocked until the Listed on Getclient badge is found on the business's website. Rejected applications get an email explaining the issue, how to fix it and where to continue. Approved listings get a welcome-to-the-directory email. Each application moves to its section as soon as you act on it.
